checklists.domotic_dishTidyUp::0:
- Final frame: dishes (plates/bowls) securely seated in dish rack slots, upright and stable, rack fully loaded or at target capacity.
- Middle frames: robot gripper grasps individual dish from source surface, transports it toward rack, aligns dish over target slot, and releases dish into slot.
- Middle frames: dishes visible in transit between source area and rack; no dishes dropped or knocked over during transfer.
- Not a problem: exact order of dish placement across slots; minor wobble of dish while settling in slot; rack position/orientation unchanged from start.
- Not a problem: lighting changes or camera angle shifts between frames; robot arm retracting to home pose after last placement.
- Not a problem: source surface (counter/sink) left empty or with leftover non-dish items; dishes stacked in rack if task allows stacking.
checklists.domotic_groceriesSorting::0:
- Final frame: vegetables only in box with pink sign; sweets only in box with yellow sign; no items left unsorted on surface.
- Middle frames: robot picks each vegetable and places it into pink-sign box; picks each sweet and places it into yellow-sign box.
- Middle frames: no item placed into the wrong colored box; no item dropped or left outside boxes.
- Not a problem: exact arrangement of items inside each box differs from reference frames.
- Not a problem: robot trajectory or speed varies between middle frames.
- Not a problem: start and end frames look identical if no groceries were present initially.
checklists.domotic_makingCoffee::0:
- Final frame shows coffee powder inside the filter of the coffee machine (powder visible in filter basket).
- Middle frames show spoon contacting coffee powder, lifting powder, moving toward machine, and tilting over filter.
- Middle frames show spoon positioned above filter while powder falls from spoon into filter.
- Not a problem: exact spoon trajectory or speed; powder spillage outside filter if powder reaches filter.
- Not a problem: start/end frames looking similar if powder already in filter initially; minor powder residue on spoon after pouring.
- Not a problem: variations in spoon fill level or machine orientation if powder enters filter.
checklists.domotic_pouringCoffee::0:
- Final frame: Coffee liquid visible inside the cup; cup upright on surface; pouring container (pot/pitcher) tilted back or set down away from cup rim.
- Middle frames: Pouring container tilted over cup opening; liquid stream connecting container spout to cup interior; cup stationary beneath flow.
- Middle frames: Coffee level rising progressively across the four middle frames inside the cup.
- No problem: Exact start/end cup position shift on table; container type (glass carafe vs metal pitcher) or color; pour speed or pause between middle frames.
- No problem: Steam or condensation on cup walls; coffee splashes on table near cup base during pour.
- Failure if: Cup tips over; liquid misses cup entirely; container never tilts past horizontal; cup empty in final frame.
checklists.domotic_setTheTable::0:
- Final frame shows: one glass, one plate, one fork left of plate, one knife right of plate, all stably placed on table surface.
- Middle frames show: robot grasping each object (glass, plate, fork, knife) and transporting it to the table vicinity.
- Middle frames show: fork placed left of plate center and knife placed right of plate center (relative positions correct).
- Middle frames show: plate placed before or simultaneously with cutlery; glass positioned without disturbing plate/fork/knife.
- Not a problem: exact pixel-perfect alignment of fork/knife parallel to plate edge; minor variations in approach paths or grasp points.
- Not a problem: start frame shows empty table; end frame matches reference end state even if intermediate object order differed.
checklists.domotic_vegetablesAndFruitsSorting::0:
- Final frame: All vegetables inside the box with a yellow mark; all fruits inside the box with a pink mark; no items left unsorted on the workspace.
- Middle frames: Robot picks up individual items; transport trajectories lead toward the correct target box (yellow-mark for vegetables, pink-mark for fruits); visible release/placement inside the correct box.
- Middle frames: No item placed into the wrong colored box (e.g., vegetable in pink-mark box or fruit in yellow-mark box).
- Not a problem: Start and end frames looking similar (e.g., boxes already pre-filled correctly in start frame).
- Not a problem: Variation in grasp pose, travel path, or speed between items.
- Not a problem: Temporary occlusion of items or boxes by the robot arm during manipulation.
checklists.industrial_robothon_buttons::0:
- Final frame: slider at top position and blue button in pushed (depressed) state.
- Middle frames: red button visibly depressed; then slider handle moving upward along track toward top.
- Middle frames: blue button contacted and depressed after slider reaches top region.
- Not a problem: exact path or speed of slider movement; brief pauses between steps.
- Not a problem: start and end frames looking similar except for button states and slider position.
- Not a problem: lighting changes or camera angle shifts that do not obscure buttons or slider.
checklists.industrial_robothon_hatchAndProbe::0:
- Final frame: hatch closed, probe inserted into black plug, no probe visible in gripper.
- Middle frames: hatch opens fully; gripper grasps probe; probe contacts tension sensor/measurement point; probe moves toward and enters black plug.
- Middle frames: probe released from gripper only after seated in black plug.
- Not a problem: exact robot arm trajectory or speed variations during motions.
- Not a problem: minor hatch angle differences in "closed" state if sealed.
- Not a problem: lighting changes or camera noise between frames.
checklists.industrial_screws_sorting::0:
- Final frame: Two distinct piles or containers separated spatially, each holding only one screw type (e.g., silver flat-head vs. black pan-head).
- Middle frames: Robot picks individual screws from the mixed source pile and places each into the correct target zone matching its type.
- Middle frames: No screw is placed into the zone designated for the other type; misplaced screws are corrected before release.
- Not a problem: Exact screw orientation or rotation within the correct target zone.
- Not a problem: Order of sorting between the two types or exact path trajectories of the gripper.
- Not a problem: Start and end frames looking similar if the source pile was already pre-sorted in the reference.
checklists.industrial_soldering::0:
- Final frame shows the part physically attached to the electronic board with a visible solder joint (metallic/shiny fillet) connecting the part leads to the board pads.
- Middle frames show the soldering iron tip contacting both the part lead and the board pad simultaneously, followed by solder wire feeding into the joint (not just touching the iron tip).
- Middle frames show the solder wire melting and flowing onto the pad/lead interface, forming a concave fillet before the iron retracts.
- Middle frames show the part held stationary (e.g., by tweezers or fixture) relative to the board during heating and cooling phases.
- Not a problem: Exact iron approach angle or solder wire feed speed variations; brief smoke/flux fumes obscuring view temporarily.
- Not a problem: Start and end frames looking similar if part was pre-placed; minor flux residue (brown/yellow) around the joint on the board.
